Join us in bringing joy to customer experience.  Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.   

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves. 

Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.

Location: San Ramon, CA; Dallas, TX; or East Coast preferred; hybrid or remote work will be considered for the right candidate

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.

Role Overview

Five9 is seeking an experienced commercial attorney for our in-house Transactions Legal Team within the Legal and Compliance organization. In this role, you will be pivotal in enabling Five9’s revenue growth by supporting the company’s sales and commercial operations. Your work will focus on drafting, reviewing, and negotiating complex commercial agreements for our cloud center platform, AI-enabled services, data processing, and security offerings. This position requires close collaboration with Sales and other cross-functional teams to support closure of complex commercial transactions and drive legal department initiatives in alignment with company business processes, policies, and objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements, including master services, data processing, partner and reseller, business associate, vendor, end user license, confidentiality, and service level agreements.
  • Prime complex legal transactions with a variety of customers and partners of different scales and sizes, across verticals such as retail, insurance, finance, and healthcare.
  • Advise internal stakeholders on liability, AI and data use, data privacy, cybersecurity, and regulatory compliance considerations within commercial agreements.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Operations, Product, Compliance, Procurement, and Finance teams to successfully close customer and partner transactions.
  • Identify legal risks and provide balanced, pragmatic solutions that support business objectives while managing legal risk in a high-pressure, high-growth environment.
  • Assist in the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of contract templates, negotiation playbooks, frequently asked questions, and scalable legal processes that improve efficiency and accelerate deal velocity.

Qualifications

Required

  • Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school.
  • Active membership in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar.
  • 7+ years of combined of law firm and in-house legal department experience.
  • 4+ years of in-house experience drafting and negotiating complex agreements in a high pressure technology sales environment.
  • Significant experience with negotiating SaaS, cloud, and other technology agreements.
  • Experience addressing issues in telecommunications, data privacy, AI, cybersecurity, and regulatory compliance.
  • Experience managing multiple projects and negotiations simultaneously in a fast-paced demanding environment.
  • Strong commercial judgment and ability to balance legal risk with business objectives.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting product teams with AI-enabled and data-driven technology products, features, and use.
  • Familiarity with data privacy and regulatory frameworks relevant to enterprise SaaS platforms, including HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2, and U.S. privacy laws (e.g., CCPA/CPRA).
  • Working knowledge of standard business processes for cloud companies, including go-to-market strategy, customer experience management, and finance processes.
  • Proficiency improving contract lifecycle management and legal operations within high-growth technology companies.

What You Will Bring

The ideal candidate has strong commercial judgment, is energetic and highly organized, and thrives in a demanding, high volume sales environment without sacrificing quality. You will have a demonstrated ability to build strong working relationships and experience advising and negotiating issues related to data privacy, liability, security, compliance, and emerging AI technologies. An excellent work ethic, drafting abilities, and interpersonal skills are essential, along with the ability to manage competing priorities.

  • A collaborative, solutions-oriented mindset, and the ability to work effectively within a team environment.
  • The ability to translate complex legal and regulatory requirements into practical and actionable business guidance.
  • Comfort navigating emerging legal and compliance issues, particularly those related to AI.
  • A proactive approach to building relationships with internal clients.

Why Join Five9

  • The opportunity to join a collaborative and business-focused legal team.
  • The ability to shape legal strategy for emerging technologies in AI, data governance, and CCaaS transactions.
  • A competitive total compensation package with comprehensive benefits.

Work Location: This role is hybrid. 3 days a week (T, W, TH) in our San Ramon office is required.

As part of our continued commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, Five9 supports pay transparency during the entire recruitment process.  Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate including, but not limited to: skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the job across the United States. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation package during your hiring process.

Additionally, the total compensation package for this position may also include an annual performance bonus, stock, and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans.

Our total reward package also includes:

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage, beginning on the first day of employment. Five9 covers 100% of the employee portion of the health, dental and vision coverage and shares a high portion of the dependent cost. We also offer Short & Long-Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, and a 401k saving plan with employer matching.
  • Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.
  • Generous employee stock purchase plan.
  • Paid Time Off, Company paid holidays, paid volunteer hours and 12 weeks paid parental leave.

All compensation and benefits are subject to the requirements and restrictions set forth in the applicable plan documents and any written agreements between the parties.

The US base salary range for this role is below.
$95,200—$265,200 USD

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.  The more inclusive we are, the better we are.  Five9 is an equal opportunity employer. 

Five9 is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@five9.com to request an accommodation. Requests will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable law.

View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9.com/pt-pt/legal.  

Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9.
